The scenario: employee (business staff) uses position to issue false delivery orders, uses company seal, takes goods out, sells low, uses proceeds to repay personal debt, rest wasted. This is embezzlement / misappropriation of company funds? In Chinese criminal law, "挪用资金" (misappropriation of funds) vs "职务侵占" (occupying by abusing position). The examples: earlier similar case: "挪用资金" used for Lin who as business staff used position to misappropriate company funds for personal purchase of lottery tickets. That was labeled "挪用资金". Actually "挪用资金" is for state-owned enterprises, public funds. "职务侵占" is for private enterprises? In Chinese law, "职务侵占罪" (embezzlement by a person in a position of trust) applies to public officials, employees of state-owned enterprises, etc. "挪用资金罪" is for state-owned enterprises? But the examples: The first example: Lin used his position as a sales staff in a company, misappropriated company funds to buy lottery tickets. The answer: "挪用资金". So they used "挪用资金" for a private company employee. So we follow that.
